# SendPulse API
> Multi-channel marketing automation platform: email campaigns, SMS, transactional SMTP, chatbots (WhatsApp, Telegram, Facebook, Instagram, Viber, TikTok, LiveChat), CRM, automation flows, web push, pop-ups, and more.
Base URL: `https://api.sendpulse.com`. Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials — POST `client_id` and `client_secret` to `/oauth/access_token` to receive a Bearer token (valid 1 hour). Alternatively, a static API Key from your account settings can be used. Include `Authorization: Bearer 
` in all requests. Full auth documentation: https://sendpulse.com/integrations/api
## Email and Messaging
- [Bulk Email API](https://api.sendpulse.com/.well-known/openapi/bulk-email.yaml): Mailing lists, email campaigns, templates, and sender management
- [SMTP API](https://api.sendpulse.com/.well-known/openapi/smtp.yaml): Transactional emails, bounce tracking, and sender identity configuration
- [SMS API](https://api.sendpulse.com/.well-known/openapi/sms.yaml): Mobile messaging, contact management, and SMS campaign orchestration
## Chatbots
- [Chatbots API](https://api.sendpulse.com/.well-known/openapi/chatbots.yaml): General cross-channel chatbot service — account info, bot listing, and dialog management
- [WhatsApp API](https://api.sendpulse.com/.well-known/openapi/whatsapp.yaml): WhatsApp chatbot integration — bots, subscribers, flows, campaigns, and chats
- [Telegram API](https://api.sendpulse.com/.well-known/openapi/telegram.yaml): Telegram chatbot integration — bots, subscribers, flows, campaigns, and chats
- [Facebook Messenger API](https://api.sendpulse.com/.well-known/openapi/facebook.yaml): Facebook Messenger chatbot integration — bots, subscribers, flows, and campaigns
- [Instagram API](https://api.sendpulse.com/.well-known/openapi/instagram.yaml): Instagram chatbot integration — bots, subscribers, flows, and campaigns
- [Viber Chatbot API](https://api.sendpulse.com/.well-known/openapi/viber-chatbot.yaml): Viber chatbot integration — bots, subscribers, flows, and campaigns
- [LiveChat API](https://api.sendpulse.com/.well-known/openapi/live-chat.yaml): SendPulse live chat widget chatbot — bots, subscribers, flows, and campaigns
- [TikTok API](https://api.sendpulse.com/.well-known/openapi/tiktok.yaml): TikTok chatbot integration — bots, subscribers, flows, and campaigns
## CRM
- [CRM API](https://api.sendpulse.com/.well-known/openapi/crm.yaml): Pipelines, deals, contacts, attributes, tags, and user management
## Automation and Tools
- [Automation 360 API](https://api.sendpulse.com/.well-known/openapi/a360.yaml): Event-driven automation flows across email, SMS, push, and messengers
- [Web Push API](https://api.sendpulse.com/.well-known/openapi/web-push.yaml): Browser push notifications, subscriber segmentation, and delivery tracking
- [Verifier API](https://api.sendpulse.com/.well-known/openapi/verifier.yaml): Email address verification and mailing list cleaning to reduce bounces and protect sender reputation
## Education
- [Education API](https://api.sendpulse.com/.well-known/openapi/edu.yaml): Online courses, students, and certificate management
## Optional
- [Viber API](https://api.sendpulse.com/.well-known/openapi/viber.yaml): Viber rich messaging with images, buttons, and SMS fallback (non-chatbot)
- [Pop-up API](https://api.sendpulse.com/.well-known/openapi/popups.yaml): Pop-up creation, management, and performance statistics
- [File Manager API](https://api.sendpulse.com/.well-known/openapi/file-manager.yaml): File upload and storage management
- [SendPulse API Index](https://api.sendpulse.com/.well-known/openapi/index.yaml): Master index listing all SendPulse sub-service API specifications

 Email campaigns 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Intuitive email builder
 
Our drag-and-drop email builder allows you to quickly and easily create professional email templates. You do not need any technical skills or HTML knowledge to develop your own template.
 
 
 
 
 
Subscription forms
 
Create a unique subscription form using your brand colors and style. Place it on your website, collect email addresses, and send them campaigns.
 
 
 
 
 
Over 130 responsive templates
 
Design and build an email template with ease. Browse our free email template gallery and select a template that meets your requirements and preferences best.
 
 
 
 
 
Resend your unopened email
 
Increase your open rate by resending your campaign with a new subject line to everyone who has not opened it.
 
 
 
 
 
Personalization
 
Leverage the subscriber data you have on hand — name, location, or date of birth — to build trust and engagement with each email you send.
 
 
 
 
 
Segmentation
 
Send emails to your clients based on their gender, location, or particular interests.
 
 
 
 
 
A/B testing
 
Test several versions of your email using different subject lines or body content. Send out the version that receives the best results.
 
 
 
 
 
Statistics
 
Our service provides detailed open and click-through statistics so that you can monitor your email campaign performance and enhance it.
 
 
 
 
 
Subscriber rating
 
Analyze your subscribers' activity, segment your mailing list, and implement a personalized approach when communicating with your audience.
 
 
 
 
 
User access levels
 
Collaborate with colleagues and partners, sharing access only to certain features. Limit their access to areas with confidential information.
 
 
 
 
 
Integration
 
Integrate our bulk email service with your CRM system or CMS. You can send emails directly from your project, track your campaigns, and view statistics.
 
 
 
 
 
Mobile app
 
Add new recipients to your mailing list, send emails, and monitor your email campaign results on the go.
 
 
 
 
 
AMP emails
 
Send interactive emails to subscribers using AMP4Email, changing your email contents in real time.
 
 
 
 
 
Email verifier
 
Verify your subscribers' email addresses and keep your mailing list clean from non-existent email addresses, spam traps, and mistyped email addresses.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Automation 360 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Multichannel marketing
 
With Automation 360, you can implement our CRM system, online course builder, web push service, chatbot builder, and email service to streamline your sales pipeline.
 
 
 
 
 
In-depth statistics
 
Gain access to detailed statistics and analyze your automated campaigns' effectiveness by time, recipients, or individual elements.
 
 
 
 
 
Data filters
 
Use filters to segment your audience by interests, status, and other personal data to customize your variables, conditions, and events for each contact.
 
 
 
 
 
Ready-made automated flows
 
Use ready-made templates with scenarios configured according to flow categories, add your data, and launch your automated flow.
 
 
 
 
 
Event-triggered flow
 
Create your own events to start an automated email flow when they are triggered.
 
 
 
 
 
Email validation in Automation 360
 
Our system automatically analyzes your email body and subject line, highlights possible variable and regular expression errors, and offers correction options.
 
 
 
 
 
API and webhooks
 
Transfer data between your system and SendPulse automatically using API or inbound webhooks.
 
 
 
 
 
Automation 360 as an app
 
Monitor your flow analytics, filter the required results, and launch, pause, or stop your flows right in the app.
 
 
 
 
 
Priority time
 
Automatically send thousands of messages via multiple communication channels right away or according to your schedule.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Chatbot builder 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Build multiple chatbots
 
Develop a Facebook, Instagram, or WhatsApp chatbot and send to bulk and personalized messages to users.
 
 
 
 
 
Facebook chatbots
 
Create automated reply flows and deliver bulk and personalized messages via your Facebook chatbot. Launch scheduled campaigns and track the number of sent and read messages and click-throughs.
 
 
 
 
 
Instagram chatbots
 
Set up automated Instagram chatbot replies to engage more users. Launch a targeted ad campaign in your Facebook account.
 
 
 
 
 
Viber chatbots
 
Develop an automated reply flow and add multimedia content to your messages. Collect the data points entered by your subscribers and send them to our CRM system for future personalization and audience segmentation.
 
 
 
 
 
WhatsApp campaigns and chatbots
 
Craft automated chatbot replies and send trigger messages with the help of an official WhatsApp Business API provider. Use a single platform to manage your chats and send replies from different devices.
 
 
 
 
 
WhatsApp Business API
 
Send personalized campaigns from your brand and chatbot messages on WhatsApp. Communicate with clients during a free 24-hour session and integrate WhatsApp with other tools.
 
 
 
 
 
Subscription widgets
 
Enable users to subscribe to your Facebook, Instagram, or WhatsApp chatbot right on your website using a widget.
 
 
 
 
 
Live chat
 
Create a live chat for your website to send automated messages triggered by user actions or behavior.
 
 
 
 
 
Automated flow builder
 
Create a series of messages that will be automatically sent to your subscribers based on their actions or keywords they use.
 
 
 
 
 
Chatbot subscriber segmentation
 
You can add variables and tags to segment your subscribers based on their gender, location, or particular interests.
 
 
 
 
 
The SendPulse Chatbots app
 
Install the app to be in touch with your subscribers and send quick replies via Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp chatbots.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Website builder 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Landing pages and online stores
 
Create websites without writing a single line of code. Publish them for free using a standard SendPulse domain or add a unique domain to increase brand awareness and get more website visitors.
 
 
 
 
 
Pre-designed templates
 
Use our responsive templates to build your own website. Our set of tools will help you add your own content and customize templates to your brand style and business needs.
 
 
 
 
 
Bio link page
 
Add multiple links to your social media bio. Share your bio link page with subscribers so that they can learn more about your products or services and connect with you using a communication channel they prefer.
 
 
 
 
 
Drag-and-drop builder
 
Design your unique landing page using our intuitive website builder. Use our pre-made design solutions and add and edit elements yourself.
 
 
 
 
 
Built-in tools and integrations
 
Add payment systems to accept payments from all over the world. Collect website visitors’ data using subscription forms and implement this information to send more relevant and personalized offers.
 
 
 
 
 
SEO and analytics
 
Amp up your search engine rankings using SEO tools and your Google Analytics data.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Online course builder
 
 
 
 
 
 
Online course development
 
Develop training programs without having a technical background. Select your course format, flow, pricing, and completion criteria and craft a certificate for your students.
 
 
 
 
 
Knowledge monetization
 
Turn your idea into a high-demand educational product that will bring in regular income. Accept payments for your courses using integrations with popular payment systems, including Stripe, Paypal, MercadoPago, and more.
 
 
 
 
 
User-friendly builder
 
With our drag-and-drop lesson builder, you can craft your course structure, adding sections, lessons, and tests. Include text, images, audio recordings, and video lectures to make your lessons more engaging and digestible.
 
 
 
 
 
Comprehensive management
 
Create sales pipelines, encourage new students to sign up for your course using subscription forms, manage contacts in your CRM system, and use other SendPulse services to enrich your communication with students.
 
 
 
 
 
Instant communication
 
Interact with your students across multiple communication channels using SMS messages and chatbots. Send email campaigns and web push notifications.
 
 
 
 
 
Convenient learning format
 
Track students' involvement in the learning process and their progress status. Support your participants at every stage of your course, answer their questions, and offer them a helping hand right on time.
 
 
 
 
 
LMS platform
 
Implement effective training programs for employees, partners, and customers to assess their knowledge and progress and provide certification.
 
 
 
 
 
Mobile app
 
Students can take your courses, complete assignments, download files, ask questions, and edit their profile in the Education by SendPulse app.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 CRM 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Sales pipeline
 
Manage your workflow at each stage of the sales pipeline — create deals, add contacts, and assign responsible team members.
 
 
 
 
 
Seamless customer communication
 
Connect with customers directly by opening a contact card or a deal. Send campaigns via email or messaging apps.
 
 
 
 
 
All customer data in one place
 
Create contact cards and update them with new customer data points. Add specific fields to your contact cards to be able to fill them with helpful notes for future interactions.
 
 
 
 
 
Adding deals automatically
 
Create deals automatically when a user takes a certain action in your automated flow, chatbot, subscription form, and more.
 
 
 
 
 
Teamwork

FAQ
 
 
 
 How do you choose the best pricing plan? 
 
 
 
 
 
SendPulse offers the following pricing plan options:
Monthly subscription: Free, Standard, Pro, and Enterprise (pricing plans differ based on the available features and mailing list size)
Pay as you go (pricing plans differ based on the available features and mailing list size. Purchased emails are valid for a year)
With the Free plan, you can send emails to up to 500 subscribers. To send emails to more users, choose one of our paid pricing plans based on the needs, size, and nature of your business.
Check our pricing page to find out more about our plans.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 How do I switch to a different plan? 
 
 
 
 
 
To change your pricing plan, determine the features you need and the size of your mailing list and follow these steps:
In your SendPulse account, go to the "Email" tab and select the "Pricing plans" section.
Click "My subscriptions" and select a pricing plan.
Click "Activate."
 
 
 
 
 
 
 How can I pay? 
 
 
 
 
 
In your SendPulse account, go to the "Email" tab and select the "Pricing plans" section.
Select a pricing plan.
We accept Visa and Mastercard credit cards. You can also pay via PayPal.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What if I change my mind? 
 
 
 
 
 
To cancel pricing plan auto-renewal, follow these steps:
In your SendPulse account, click the avatar in the upper-right corner and go to "Payments."
Select a pricing plan you want to disable and click "Cancel subscription."
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What is the difference between monthly subscription plans and pay-as-you-go plans? 
 
 
 
 
 
Monthly subscription plans are auto-renewable, meaning that you will be charged for your pricing plan each month from the moment you activate it;
Pay-as-you-go plans allow you to send a certain number of campaigns throughout the year. To send more emails, buy a pay-as-you-go plan again.
